Rationale.C1_All_Runnable: All 27 core analysis blocks run without errors. The 4 non-runnable blocks are optional baseline comparison libraries (RAGAS, RefChecker, TruLens, Groq) that are not installed but are not required for core functionality.
Rationale.C2_All_Correct: All 34 blocks have correct implementations matching the computation described in Plan and CodeWalkthrough files.
Rationale.C3_No_Redundant: One redundant block found: predict.py/preprocess_data duplicates classifier.py/preprocess_data functionality.
Rationale.C4_No_Irrelevant: All blocks contribute to the project goal of hallucination detection using ECS/PKS scores.

Special_Cases.Note: These are optional baseline comparison methods, not core analysis code
